(Bloomberg) -- Electric-vehicle maker XPeng Inc. is poised to raise about HK$14 billion ($1.8 billion) in its Hong Kong listing, people with knowledge of the matter said, putting it on track to be the first Chinese EV producer to finish a so-called homecoming share sale.

The U.S.-listed firm is planning to price its Hong Kong shares at HK$165 each, said the people, who asked not to be identified as the information is private. That represents a discount of about 4.1% to its closing price of $44.
